_comment: LIVE telemetry from community SONiC 202505 on physical Dell Z9100-ON switch #2 (service tag SERIAL-A), idle, captured 2026-08-20 via serial + gNMI from the Mac. Companion to z9100-sonic-telemetry.json (switch #1, SERIAL-B).
install_notes: Identical procedure to switch #1: Esc-interrupt Dell autoboot -> grub> -> boot ONIE 4.1.28 kernel with boot_reason=rescue -> sgdisk delete Dell partitions 3-12 -> onie-nos-install -> config reload -y -f -> enable thermalctld. Serial gotcha: grub line editor drops chars at 115200, must send commands char-by-char.

power_watts._note: show platform psustatus; OS9 baseline for this box was 70+82=152 W total.

temperature_c._asic_note: Tomahawk; a touch cooler than switch #1 (36.1 C)

streaming_subscribe.note: A single pygnmi run of real-hardware/gnmi-probe-hw.py on 2026-08-20. Seen once from the probe and not repeated, so Subscribe is not treated as proven on this hardware.

FINDING_1: Same as switch #1: pmon_daemon_control.json shipped skip_thermalctld:true; flipped to false + restarted pmon to expose thermals over gNMI. Backup saved as .orig on the box.
